spans.s:
स्तोतव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be praised, deserving
praise, laudable.
स्तोतव्य स्तोतव्य, स्तोतृ, स्तोत्र. See p. 1143.

स्तोतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, praising, a praiser, panegyrist,
flatterer.

स्तोत्र, अम्, n. praise, eulogium, a hymn of praise,
ode.
—स्तोत्रार्ह (˚र-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, worthy of
praise.

स्तोत्रीया, f. a particular kind of verse consisting
of eighty syllables.

. fr.
rt. स्तु), praise, eulogium, a hymn, (see सूक्त);
sacrifice, oblation; a Soma libation; a heap, collec-
tion, assemblage, number, multitude, quantity, mass
[cf. स्तवक, col. 1]; (अम्), n. the head; riches;
wealth; grain, corn; an iron-pointed stick or staff
or one bound with iron; (अस्, आ, अम्), crooked,
bent (according to some).
—स्तोम-तष्ट, अस्, आ,
अम्, Ved. composed by poets, (Sāy. = स्तोम-का-
रिभिः कृत.)
—स्तोम-वाहस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. per-
forming or offering hymns of praise.

स्तोमय (referred in native lists to a rt. स्तोम्,
but rather to be regarded as a Nom. fr. स्तोम above),
Nom. or cl. 10. P. स्तोमयति, अतुस्तोमत्, स्तोम-
यितुम्, to praise, laud, hymn.

स्तोम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be praised, praiseworthy,
laudable.

स्तोभ, अस्, m. stopping, obstructing; a stop,
pause; disrespect, contumely; hymn, praise; a
division of the Sāma-veda, (see साम-वेद, p. 1107);
an insertion, anything inserted.
—स्तोभ-च्छला, f.,
N. of a chapter of the Sāma-veda-cchalā, q. v.
—स्तोभ-प्रकृति, इस्, f., N. of part of the Sāma-
veda.
—स्तोभानुसंहार (˚भ-अन्˚), अस्, m., N.
of a short treatise on Śikṣā (one of the Pariśiṣṭas
of the Sāma-veda).
स्तोभ स्तोभ, &c. See under rt. 1. स्तुभ्.

स्तोक स्तोक, अस्, आ, अम्, little, small, short;
few; low; (अस्), m. a small portion, drop (of water,
ghee, &c.); the Cātaka bird; (अम्), ind. a little;
less; [cf. Lith. stokoju, ‘I want.’]
—स्तोक-काय,
अस्, ई, अम्, little-bodied, small, diminutive.
—स्तोक-
नम्र, अस्, आ, अम्, a little bent down, slightly de-
pressed.
—स्तोक-शस्, ind. sparingly.
स्तोकक, अस्, m. the Cātaka bird.

स्तोम् स्तोम्. See स्तोमय, p. 1143,
col. 2.
